{{Quote|Bear in mind, too, that Liaison Nyama speaks for the Stromma council, and some of those members still blame us for the destruction their worlds suffered.|Grand Admiral Thrawn, to [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]]|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
'''Stromma Council Liaison''' was a title held by individuals who spoke for the [[Stromma council]], the government of the [[Stromma]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Crisis of FaithD">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> the Stromma [[Nyama]] held the title, serving as a liaison between the Stromma council and the [[Empire of the Hand]], a government in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Nyama attended a strategy conference aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'', where he learned how [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], the [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] of the Empire of the Hand, planned to [[Attack on the Red City|attack]] the forces of [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] on the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]. As Stromma Council Liaison, he remarked that the Stromma council would not waste its [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] in an attack the liaison considered "mad," withdrawing all Stromma from the Empire of the Hand's service.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Stromma Council Liaison appeared in the novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
